parameters.name: AvailableSpectrumRequest
parameters.description: Represents the full JSON Available Spectrum Inquiry request payload sent by the AFC client to the AFC server.

parameters.name: AvailableSpectrumResponse
parameters.description: Contains the JSON response payload received from the AFC server corresponding to the {{param|AvailableSpectrumRequest}} parameter.

parameters.name: GrantExpiryTime
parameters.description: This parameter contains the time when the spectrum availability specified in the response expires. This field SHALL be included if and only if the response code indicates SUCCESS as per {{bibref|AFCSDI|Table 19. AvailableSpectrumInquiryResponse object}}. The string value SHALL be represented in UTC and conform to the following format: "YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ".

parameters.name: GrantStatus
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the AFC grant request. It indicates the Response Name associated with the Response Code received in the latest Available Inquiry Spectrum Response as defined in {{bibref|AFCSDI|Table 25. Response Code definitions}}.

parameters.name: GrantResponse
parameters.description: Human-readable interpretation of the grant status as defined in {{bibref|AFCSDI|Table 25. Response Code definitions}}. For example, "Incompatible interface version number" for response code 100.

object.description: Object that contains information about AFC requests and responses.
